tools.name: tells_check_writing
tools.description: Use when the user asks whether a piece of writing sounds like AI, wants an email, post, essay or cover letter checked for chatbot habits before sending, or wants to know which phrases to fix. Returns a 0-100 score, a verdict, and each habit found (chatbot words like "delve" and "tapestry", "not X, i

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: tells_check_writing · Public sink: tells_check_writing.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: tells_check_writing · Public sink: tells_check_writing

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
